meta.title: Smart Tree — Arafah Green Legacy
meta.tagline: Smart Tree: Green Arafah, Brighter Tomorrow

quality.label: Graphics quality
quality.lowHint: Light and fluid for phones and older laptops
quality.highHint: Full detail for devices with a strong GPU
quality.note: The page reloads at the same chapter.

trunk_base.name: Main Trunk
trunk_base.desc: The main structure, stacked in tiers like Lego with hidden male-female joints that blend into the wood texture. Easy to take apart, move and reassemble; its hollow core houses the technology modules.

green_tank.name: Water Tank
green_tank.desc: Water tank of the closed-loop system. Water is pumped from the tank to the planting modules and roots, then returns to the tank, saving water in dry environments.

distribution_pipe.name: Distribution Pipe
distribution_pipe.desc: Carries water from the pump to the planting modules and roots as part of the closed water loop.

nutrient_tank.name: Nutrient Tanks A & B
nutrient_tank.desc: Nutrient tanks A and B. Nutrient levels are monitored through electrical conductivity (EC), targeting about {ec}.

battery.name: Battery & Charge Controller
battery.desc: Stores energy for the Smart Tree’s smart systems. Battery status and solar panel power are monitored via IoT.

tree_crown.name: Canopy
tree_crown.desc: A green canopy that creates a shady, pleasant and cool space for pilgrims, visitors and tourists.

solar_panel.name: Solar Panel
solar_panel.desc: A {power} solar panel that powers the Smart Tree’s smart systems and supports energy efficiency.

branch_apple.name: Apple Branch
branch_apple.desc: Apple planting module. One Smart Tree can host several plant species, chosen through biological needs analysis and testing.

branch_mango.name: Mango Branch
branch_mango.desc: Mango planting module. One Smart Tree can host several plant species, chosen through biological needs analysis and testing.

branch_grape.name: Grape Branch
branch_grape.desc: Grape planting module. One Smart Tree can host several plant species, chosen through biological needs analysis and testing.

branch_orange.name: Orange Branch
branch_orange.desc: Orange planting module. One Smart Tree can host several plant species, chosen through biological needs analysis and testing.

loading.label: Loading progress
loading.error: The 3D models failed to load. Check the connection, then reload.

intro.title: Greening Arafah
intro.body1: Our vision: a greener, more comfortable, shaded and refreshing environment for Hajj and Umrah pilgrims, visitors and tourists in Arafah.
intro.body2: Inspired by the story of the “Soekarno Trees”, the Arafah greening program by President Soekarno in 1955, now carried forward with modern technology.

reveal.title: Living Plant + Modular Structure + Smart Technology
reveal.body1: A smart modular tree built on IoT and hydroponics, for greening hot and dry regions.

movable.title: Movable
movable.text: Easy to take apart, move and reassemble.

reveal.hint: Hover or tap a module to see its details.

assembly.title: Assembled like Lego
assembly.body1: Each module locks in with hidden male-female joints that blend into the wood texture, so the tree is easy to take apart, move and reassemble.
assembly.hint: Press “Reassemble” to watch the modules lock in one by one.

water.title: Closed-loop water
water.body1: Water circulates in a closed-loop system for water efficiency in dry environments.

tank.title: Tank
tank.text: Water is stored in the tank at the base of the trunk.

pump.title: Pump
pump.text: The pump moves water up through the distribution pipe.

roots.title: Roots
roots.text: Water reaches the planting modules and their roots on every branch.

return.title: Return
return.text: Water flows back down to the tank to circulate again.

dashboard.title: IoT Dashboard

pump.toggle: Turn the pump on or off

dashboard.note: All values are simulated for demonstration, not real sensor data.

core.title: Core design
core.text: The Smart Tree foundations shown in this 3D model.

app.title: App features
app.text: Additional features of the Smart Tree monitoring app.

rnd.title: Research & development
rnd.text: Still in research and not yet a working feature.

modular.title: Modular structure
modular.text: Stacked in tiers like Lego; easy to take apart, move and reassemble.

water.title: Closed-loop water
water.text: Tank → pump → planting modules and roots → back to the tank.

iot.title: IoT sensors & automation
iot.text: Sensors read parameters and trigger the system automatically, such as irrigation.

solar.title: Solar energy
solar.text: {power} solar panel with battery status monitoring.

plants.title: Planting modules
plants.text: One tree for several plant species, such as mango, orange, apple and grape.

awg.title: AWG / Dew Harvester
awg.text: Atmospheric Water Generator to capture water from the air.

recovery.title: Water Recovery & Transpiration
recovery.text: Reuses water condensed from plant transpiration.
